half year ended 30 September, 2026 and to consider the proposal for raising fund s through the issuance of 
securities by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement.

the following:

year ended 30 September, 2026, submitted in accordance with the Listing Regulations. The financial 
results will also be published in the prescribed format under the Listing Regulations, together with a QR 
code providing access to the same on the Company’s website; 
b) The audit reports issued by the Joint Statutory Au ditors of the Company, M/s. B.K. Khare & Co., 
Chartered Accountants, and M/s. KKC & Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants, on the audited 
standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30 
September 2026;
